model: SEG AUTOADAPT grinder pumps with CIU 202 / CIU 262 / CIU 502 (Modbus)
applies_to: Up to four Grundfos SEG AUTOADAPT grinder pumps in one or more pits, connected to a CIU 202 (Modbus RTU), CIU 262 (cellular) or CIU 502 (Modbus TCP); functional profile 96846341 (2019-01).
summary: SEG AUTOADAPT grinder pumps carry their own level sensing and control; a CIU box links up to four of them to a Modbus master. The map covers the pit commands and start/stop levels for single-pit and multi-pit operation, pit state and alarm bits, pit energy and run-time counters, and a 50-register block per pump with temperatures, voltage, current, power, energy, starts, level and alarm/warning bits.

addressing.note: The manual says registers numbered X are addressed in telegrams as X - 1 (00104 is sent as 103). Pump n's block starts at 00401 + 50 x (n-1).

source.title: Modbus for SEG AUTOADAPT - CIU 202 Modbus RTU, CIU 262 3G/4G Cellular, CIU 502 Ethernet for Modbus TCP - Functional profile and user manual
source.pages: p. 16 (block overview), pp. 17-19 (CIM blocks), pp. 20-26 (pit control and status), p. 27 (pit data), pp. 28-35 (pump blocks), p. 43 (telegram addressing)

notes: 32-bit values are HI/LO register pairs with the HI part at the lower address, so they are ABCD.
All registers can be read with function 03 or 04 and are listed as holding registers. 0xFFFF means not available.
Pumps 2-4 repeat the pump 1 layout at +50 (00451, 00501, 00551); checked against the printed pump 2-4 tables.

Left out: register 00202, because its bit names (bit 0 AlarmInPumpOrPit, bit 1 WarningInPumpOrPit) contradict their descriptions; 00235 carries the same main status consistently and is listed instead. Also left out: the acknowledge register 00201, CIU 262-only cellular registers (RTC, 00236-00239) and user registers.
Motor and electronics temperatures are printed in 0.01 K; no 273.15 offset is applied here.

registers.name: RegisterOffset
registers.description: Offset added to addresses above 00100; default 0.

registers.name: PitControl
registers.description: Command bits, act on a 0 to 1 edge.

bits.10: PitPump1PumpDown (pump down once, then level control stops it)
bits.11: PitPump2PumpDown (pump down once, then level control stops it)
bits.12: PitPump3PumpDown (pump down once, then level control stops it)
bits.13: PitPump4PumpDown (pump down once, then level control stops it)

registers.name: AlarmCode
registers.description: Grundfos alarm code of the pit (see manual section 14.2).

registers.name: WarningCode
registers.description: Grundfos warning code of the pit.

registers.name: WaterLevel
registers.description: Pit level estimated by the pumps; single-pit mode.

registers.name: MaxWaterLevel
registers.description: Highest level seen; reset with ResetHistory.

registers.name: OnTimeCnt
registers.description: CIU power-on time; cannot be reset.

registers.name: OprTimeTripCnt
registers.description: Time with one or more pumps running.

registers.name: PumpOperationTimePct
registers.description: Share of time pumping, last 30 days.

registers.name: MultiPumpOperationTimePct
registers.description: Share of pumping time with several pumps, 30 days.

integration.summary: Read 00230-00235 for pump presence, running, alarm and the pit main status, 00301 for the pit level, and each pump block for current, power and alarm bits. Force pumps with 00122-00125 or use the PumpDown bits of PitControl 00101.
integration.enable: Set the CIU 202 address with the hex rotary switches and the speed and parity with the DIP switches; no setting is needed in the pumps. Write the pit levels only in the mode selected by PitMode (00203).
quirks: Control bits are rising-edge commands; with AutoAckControlBits = 1 (default) the CIU clears them.
Single-pit and multi-pit level registers are separate; the unused set is ignored.
setup: CIU 202 default 19200 baud, even parity, 1 stop bit.
gotchas: A changed RegisterOffset (00002) shifts all addresses above 00100.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
